About Me

I am a Cybersecurity Risk Assessment Expert specializing in Cybersecurity Risk Analysis & Vulnerability Management. I help organizations identify, evaluate, and mitigate security threats across diverse IT environments, ensuring that critical systems remain secure and compliant. With hands-on experience in Windows and Linux System Administration, as well as Network Infrastructure & Virtualization, I design and implement resilient security strategies that protect enterprise networks and cloud systems. My background also includes working with Navy Tactical Systems and Submarine Training Simulations, giving me a unique perspective on mission-critical and highly secure environments. I am passionate about Team Leadership & Management, fostering collaborative environments where technical teams thrive while achieving security objectives. By combining strategic risk assessment with practical system administration expertise, I deliver actionable insights that strengthen organizational defenses and reduce exposure to cyber threats.
